arguments.title: Regularized Discrete Optimal Transport
key_claims: Relaxed mass conservation and graph regularization help transfer multimodal color distributions without amplifying noise. This motivates a constrained fixture-assignment oracle and distributional objectives rather than collapsing a palette to its mean RGB. The paper is image recoloring, not a physical lighting controller: fixture gamut, overlap, emitted luminance and temporal transitions must be constrained independently. Histogram matching alone ignores spatial layout. Keep a regional held-out error and palette-permutation control; an oracle improvement establishes output capacity only.
